description: If PA derives the same base and successor recursion equations for arbitrary arithmetic graphs \(F,G\), with the same base and step graphs, PA derives the universal equivalence of \(F,G\).
signature:

  (F G : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Unit))
  (B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit))
  (H : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin (n + 2) ⊕ Unit))
  (hF0 :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.allClose
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.recursionZeroFormula F B)))
  (hG0 :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.allClose
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.recursionZeroFormula G B)))
  (hFS :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.allClose
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.recursionSuccessorFormula F H)))
  (hGS :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.allClose
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.recursionSuccessorFormula G H))) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.PAEquivalent F G
